correctness.notes: oracle passed on every measured cell | 23 cells reported unsupported by the adapter's supported(), listed in correctness.unsupported_cells | phase 3 final evaluation, harness 0.10, nodes gb200-nvl4-ts2-99

low_level: Registers 18 to 127 over the 142 distinct kernels behind the card's cells (0 with register spills, a kernel measured in more than one batch counts once), shared memory 64 to 3088 bytes, harness 0.10 on gb200-nvl4-ts2-99.
Adapter statics: input arrangement blocked, output indices, temp storage 20 to 1028 bytes.
Oracle battery (23 cases per cell plus the measurement seeds) passed on every cell that has a number, 23 cells unsupported by the adapter's contract or the device, no cell failed the oracle.
algorithmic: Random input (the one-node matrix on gb200-nvl4-ts2-99): latency not_guaranteed wins 2 of 35 cells (runner-up in 11), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 2 of 34 cells (runner-up in 12), throughput not_guaranteed wins 1 of 39 cells (runner-up in 5), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 1 of 34 cells (runner-up in 6).
Where it wins on random input (bf16 N 4096, fp32 N 4096), the median margin over the runner-up is +3 percent and over the scope's reference control +124 percent.

Largest random-input deficits (distinct cells, worst regime): fp32 N 8192 k 256 +1247 percent behind B4_v4 in throughput not_guaranteed, bf16 N 1024 k 256 +1032 percent behind B3_tuned in latency not_guaranteed, fp32 N 1024 k 256 +1019 percent behind N9_w2fin2 in latency not_guaranteed, fp32 N 4096 k 256 +840 percent behind B1_det2 in throughput not_guaranteed.
negative: Above 32 items per thread (N 16384 and above at 256 threads, outside the GB200 pass) the packed list spills to local memory on B200 (T34), the GB200 cells up to N 8192 run without spills.
The GB200 pass measured random input only on one host (gb200-nvl4-ts2-99): the tie_heavy, shuffled-tie and phase 3b order-check findings for this adapter are on its B200 card.
surprises: None beyond what the tables show.
open_questions: A two-level list or a smaller per-lane window for N above 8192.

B200 pass (WINNERS_b200.md, random input on umbriel-b200-047, tie_heavy on 068, shuffled ties on 094, phase 3b on 047): the warp and sub-warp winners agree with GB200 on 359 of 376 common cells (365 of 376 when each cell is compared through the adapters both passes measured, as section 16 of the knowledge base does), the differences are named sub-warp lane-count cells, N 128 sub-warp throughput cells and warp ties within 5 percent, and in the block matrices the B1_idx against B1_det2 throughput ties fall either way. On GB200 the k 64 cells at 128 threads run 3 to 15 percent slower than on B200 (hw-researcher, a generation property) and the aarch64 cicc emits branches for the conditional swaps (T20, 3 to 4 percent).
